nodes.label: Sir Reginald Vance
nodes.description: Wealthy, eccentric clockmaker who was murdered in his private study.

nodes.label: The Clock Tower Study
nodes.description: Soundproofed third-floor room with a deafening mechanical clock that chimes every hour for 60 seconds.

nodes.label: The Billiards Room
nodes.description: Ground floor recreation room where Arthur claimed to be playing alone.

nodes.label: Brass Clock Weight
nodes.description: A heavy mechanical component used to strike the victim down instantly.

nodes.label: Spare Study Key
nodes.description: The key kept in Miss Croft's desk drawer that grants access to the study.

nodes.label: Arthur Vance
nodes.description: Sir Reginald's estranged nephew and desperate gambler. The actual murderer.

metadata.public_alibi: Practicing trick shots alone in the billiards room from 3:15 PM to 4:15 PM.
metadata.hidden_secret: Owes £10,000 to dangerous bookmakers; sneaked out to steal the key and commit the murder.
metadata.interrogation_weakness: Cannot provide technical details about his supposed billiard game, and cannot explain why the room was seen empty at 3:45 PM.

nodes.label: Lady Eleanor Vance
nodes.description: The younger, glamorous wife of the victim.

metadata.public_alibi: Cutting roses in the garden at 3:45 PM; claims she heard her husband shouting inside his room.
metadata.hidden_secret: Having an affair with Dr. Miller. Visited the study at 3:50 PM to steal her love letters back, proving Reginald was alive then.
metadata.interrogation_weakness: Lied about hearing shouts. Since the room is 100% soundproof, she could not have heard anything from the garden, exposing her presence near the room.

nodes.label: Dr. Quentin Miller
nodes.description: Sir Reginald's personal physician and secret lover of Lady Eleanor.

metadata.public_alibi: Waiting patiently in the drawing room from 3:30 PM until 4:15 PM.
metadata.hidden_secret: Spotted Lady Eleanor going upstairs to the study at 3:50 PM and is trying to protect her from suspicion.
metadata.interrogation_weakness: If forced to describe the drawing room layout, he must admit he was looking at the stairs, proving he saw who moved through the house.

nodes.label: Miss Beatrice Croft
nodes.description: The strict, fiercely loyal secretary who manages the estate.

metadata.public_alibi: Served tea at 3:00 PM, then went to the kitchen at 3:45 PM to check on dinner.
metadata.hidden_secret: Accidentally left her desk drawer unlocked between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM, leaving the spare key exposed.
metadata.interrogation_weakness: Her extreme pride makes her deny mistakes, but when confronted with Dr. Miller's observation of the open drawer, she will break and admit her oversight.

edges.relationship: Nephew of (and murdered due to gambling debts)
Wife of (and stealing love letters from)
Secretly having an romantic affair with
Observed that room was completely empty
Entered room to steal letters, saw victim alive
Witnessed walking toward the study stairs
Struck victim with brass weight during loud clock chime
Discovered the corpse along with Miss Croft
